title: "MORE" Casserole
ingredients: 1 12 or 16 oz. pkg rotini style pasta
steps: Brown ground beef and drain
Add garlic, salt, sugar, tomato sauce and simmer for 20 minutes
Add mushrooms
Cook pasta, drain and toss with 1 T. oil
Beat together cream cheese, sour cream and onions
In a casserole pan, layer 1/2 of the pasta, 1/2 of the cheese mixture and 1/2 of the meat mixture
Repeat layer and top with cheese
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly

title: Amish Hash Browns
steps: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, cornmeal, salt and baking powder
Add potatoes, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, eggs and onion and mix until evenly blended
Heat 1/4 cup of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Drop heaping tablespoons of the potatoes into the hot oil, flattening slightly
Cook until browned on the bottom and then flip over and cook the other side
Keep warm in oven while frying the rest

title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can 14 oz. artichoke hearts (drain and chop)
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: Asparagus and Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 (2-inch) pieces peeled fresh ginger, cut into thin matchsticks
2 bunches medium asparagus, woody stems trimmed, sliced into 1-inch pieces
1 bunch scallions (white and green parts), thinly sliced
Serve with brown or white rice
steps: Freeze the chicken breast for 20 minutes and then thinly slice the chicken against the grain into strips
Toss the strips with about half the garlic and ginger, soy sauce, sugar, 1 t. cornstarch and salt in a bowl
Marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes
Mix the remaining cornstarch with the broth
Heat 1 t. of oil in a large skillet over high heat
Add the asparagus, scallions, remaining garlic, ginger, 1/4 cup of water and season with 1/4 t. salt
Stir-fry until the asparagus is bright green but still crisp, about 3 minutes
Transfer to a bowl
Heat the same skillet until very hot, then add remaining 1 T. oil
Add the chicken and stir-fry until it loses its raw color and gets a little brown, about 3 minutes
Return the asparagus to the pan and toss to heat through
Stir in the remaining cornstarch mixture and bring to a full boil to thicken
Mound the stir-fry on a serving platter and serve with rice

title: Baklava
steps: Mix filling thoroughly and divide into 4 parts
Melt butter
Line 9X13 pan with layer of filo pastry
Crisp in 350 degree oven
Brush with melted butter and add 6-8 layers brushing each with butter
Sprinkle 1/4 nut mixture over top and repeat process until all ingredients are used
End with pastry layer on top
Pour the remaining butter over top
Before baking, cut in diamond shapes
Bake 325 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour
Remove from oven and pour 1/2 syrup over top
When cool pour remaining syrup over top

title: Banana Bread
steps: Grease the bottom and sides of a loaf pan
Mix together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and 1/8 t. of salt
In another bowl, combine the eggs, bananas, sugar and cooking oil. Mix with the dry mixture.
Fold in nuts (optional)
Spoon batter into the prepared pan
Bake 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes

title: Beach Club Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cooked and sliced
4 cups spinach leaves, rinsed and dried
1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried
steps: Mix all ingredients for salad and put aside
Mix all ingredients for dressing
Add dressing to salad

title: Blueberry Crisp
notes: Handwritten "flour" is written above/in place of "water" in the ingredient list.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Butter a 8 or 9 inch baking dish
Put blueberries in the bottom of the dish
With a folk mix the flour, sugar, cinnamon, butter and salt to make a crumbly mixture. Spread over fruit
Bak 45 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream

title: Butter Frosting
steps: In a mixing bowl beat butter till fluffy
Gradually add 2 cups of powder sugar, beating well
Slowly beat in the 1/4 cup milk and vanilla
Slowly beat in remaining powder sugar
Beat in additional milk, if needed, to reach spreading consistency
If desired, tint with food coloring

title: Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 egg yolk (wash outside of egg well)
steps: Brown bread cubes in oil and garlic if desired
Mix oil, garlic, worchestershire sauce, salt, pepper and mustard
When ready to serve, toss torn lettuce with lemon juice, blue cheese, parmesan and egg yolk
Add bread cubes and dressing
Toss

title: Chocolate Decadence Cake
steps: Melt butter with chocolate
Add sugar, egg yolks, flour and almonds to chocolate mixture
Add cream of tarter to egg whites and beat until peaks form
Fold mixtures together gently
Pour into 8-9" round pan
Bake 350 degrees for 35-45 minutes or until cake is completely set around the sides but still has a soft center
Cool thoroughly in pan
To serve dust cake with powder sugar and top with softly whipped cream flavored with powder sugar and vanilla

title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Line 9-inch pan with foil, with ends of foil extending over sides of pan, set aside
Place sugar, butter and evaporated milk in large saucepan
Bring to full boil on medium heat, stirring constantly
Boil 4 minutes
Remove from heat
Add chocolate and marshmallow creme, stir until completely melted
Add walnuts and vanilla, mix well
Pour immediately into prepared pans, spread to form even layer in pan
Let stand at room temperature for 4 hours or until completely cooled
Cut into 1-inch squares
Store in tightly covered containers at room temperature

title: Cream puffs
steps: Heat over to 375 degrees.
In a medium saucepan, heat the water and butter until the butter melts.
Add the flour all at once and beat with a wooden spoon until dough forms a ball in the center of the pan.
Remove from heat and add 1 egg. Beat until well blended. Add the second egg and beat again until well blended.
Arrange by spoonful (about a tablespoon) on an untreated cookie sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake until there are no beads of moisture on the puffs (about 40 minutes).
Cool, split and fill with custard/pudding filling or ice cream and drizzle with chocolate sauce.

title: Dad's Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: Peal 4-6 potatoes and dice into cubes (or use frozen hashbrowns)
Can of cream of chicken soup
steps: Grease a pan
Combine all of the ingredients and pour into the prepared pan.
Cook on 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: Dad's pumpkin pie crust and filling
steps: Use a 10 inch pie pan.
Mix all of the crust ingredients and spread in the pie pan.
Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes.
Combine all of the filling ingredients and add to the cooked pie crust.
Bake at 375 degrees for 40-45 minutes.

title: Dad's Pumpkin Roll
steps: Grease cookie sheet and put wax paper down and sprinkle flour over wax paper
Beat all ingredients in batter and pour into pan
Spread liquid over cooking sheet
Bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees
Put dish towel down and sprinkle with powder sugar
Dump cooking sheet over on town and peel back wax paper
Roll layer into towel and let it cool
Mix all filling ingredients
Unroll towel and layer filling
Roll back up (not using towel) and wrap in wax paper
Refrigerate and cut into slices to serve

title: Dream Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Melt butter in a 9X9 pan in oven.
After butter has melted remove pan from oven and add graham cracker crumbs.
Press graham cracker crumbs evenly on the bottom of the pan.
Spread the chocolate chips evenly over graham crackers and finish with coconut.
Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over the coconut and sprinkle chopped nuts on top.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting in squares.

title: Emma's Favorite Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1-2 1/2 lbs chicken, cooked and deboned (1 buy a cooked chicken from grocery store)
steps: Cook chicken or pick the store bought chicken into small pieces.
In a large pot, melt butter and add oil.
When hot, add onions, jalapeño, garlic, carrots, and celery. Sauté for 5 minutes.
Add chicken, vegetable mixture and corn to a large pot.
Add cumin, chili powder, salt, lemon pepper, hot sauce, flour, tomatoes, lime juice and broth.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes.
Serve soup with broken up tortilla chips, diced avocado, sour cream, cilantro and grated cheese.

title: Escalloped Broccoli
ingredients: 1 pkg frozen chopped broccoli or fresh-cooked and drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Mix together the soup, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, egg and onion flakes
Mix with broccoli
Spoon into a greased casserole, sprinkle with crumbs and dot with butter
Bake for 45 minutes

title: French Peasant Bread
steps: Combine the water, yeast, sugar and salt until dissolved.
Stir in flour and put out onto a floured plate.
Grease a bowl and return the dough to the bowl and cover.
Let it rise for 45 minutes until double in size.
Flour hands and take out and place in 2 parts on a greased cornmealed cookie sheet.
Let it raise until double in size (about 45 minutes).
Brush top with melted butter and bake for 10 minutes at 425 and then 20 minutes at 375 degrees.
Take out and brush with butter.

title: Grandma Zippay Famous Golabki
steps: To make the filling: Cook 1/2 cup of rice with 1 tsp. butter and set aside. Cook ground pork and onions with salt and pepper, 1/2 c water and 2 t. Chicken bouillon seasoning. Drain and combine with rice. Set aside.
Wash cabbage and cut around the core. Put whole cabbage in pot of boiling water. Pull leaves of cabbage as they become done and set aside. Cut off the membrane on the back of the cabbage.
Take cabbage leaf and fill it with pork mixture. Roll leaf while pushing ends inward. Continue until all leaves are filled.
Retain 2 cups of the remaining cabbage water and add chicken base to water and bring to a boil
Reduce heat to medium and add cabbage rolls
Add ketchup, BBQ sauce, remaining cabbage (chopped) and tomatoes
Simmer for 1 hours- taste to see if you need more ketchup or BBQ sauce

Before you serve in a separate pan melt 1 stick of butter, with 1/2 diced onion, brown butter. Add a heaping tablespoon of floor and add this mixture to the pot to thicken sauce. You may need to take some liquid out if too much.

title: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocados and add remaining ingredients
Salt to taste

title: Herb Roasted Prime Rib
steps: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees and put the rib roast in a large roasting pan and set aside.

Put the olive oil, rosemary, sage, thyme, salt, pepper and garlic in a food processor and pulse until everything is combined, but there are still some chunks of herbs. Rub the mixture all over the roast.

Roast for 20 minutes, then lower the over temperature to 325 degrees. Roast until the internal temperature registers 130 degrees for medium rare, about 2 hours. Let rest for 10-15 minutes, then slice into 1/2 to 1 inch pieces.

title: Holiday Sticky Buns
ingredients: 12 T unsalted butter at room temperature
1/3 c light brown sugar, lightly packed
1/2 c pecans, chopped into large pieces
1 package (17.3 oz/2 sheets) frozen puff pastry, defrosted
2 T unsalted butter, melted and cooled
2/3 c light brown sugar, lightly packed
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees and place a 12 cup standard muffin tin on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper.

In a bowl of an electric mixer, combine 12 T butter and 1/3 c brown sugar. Place 1 rounded tablespoon of the mixture in each of the muffin cups. Distribute the pecans evenly among the muffin cups on top of the butter mixture.

Lightly flour a stone surface. Unfold one sheet of the puff pastry with the folds going left to right. Brush the whole sheet with 1 T of butter. Leaving a 1 inch border on the puff pastry, sprinkle each sheet with 1/3 cup of brown sugar and 1 1/2 t of cinnamon. Starting with the end nearest you, roll the pastry up snugly like a jelly roll around the filling. Finish the roll with the seam side down. Slice the roll into 6 equal pieces, about 1 1/2 inches. Place each piece, spiral side up in muffin tin and repeat for the second sheet of puff pastry.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the sticky buns are golden brown on top and firm to touch. Allow to cool for 5 minutes only, invert the buns onto the parchment paper and cool completely.

title: Hovegi (Stuffed Crepes)
ingredients: 2 T melted butter, plus extra for cooking.
1 head of cabbage, remove core and dice up
steps: Make crepes by beating the eggs and then add in milk, salt, flour and butter.
Cover and let stand for 30 minutes.
Heat a 7 or 5 inch skillet until moderately hot, then add butter.
Ladle in several tablespoons of batter, then quickly tilt the pan to coat with patter for the thinnest layer possible.
Cook for a few minutes and then flip it over for a few more minutes.
The pancakes should slide loosely about in the pan.
Filling:
Sauté the cabbage in butter and add salt to taste until soft.
Peel the potatoes and chop into small pieces.
Cook the potatoes until soft and drain water.
Using a mixer, whip the potatoes with cheese, butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Mix the potatoes into the cabbage.
Take a crepe and fill it down the center with the potato/cabbage mixture. Roll up the crepe and serve seam side down.

title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1 container of fresh mushrooms, sliced thin
steps: Combine the chicken stock, carrots, celery and mushrooms.
Bring to a boil and add salt and pepper.
Mix the pork, cheese and break crumbs until combined with salt and pepper.
Roll into tiny meatballs and add to the boiling soup.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Boil the orzo separately for 9 minutes and drain water.
Serve soup with extra parmesan cheese on side.

title: Judy's Christmas Swedish Toscas
steps: Cream butter and gradually add sugar
Blend in flour and divide into 24 1/2" muffin cups
Press into bottoms and up sides
Bake 350 degrees for 10 minutes
Combine remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils
Divide into partially baked cookie shells
Bake 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until light brown
Cool in pan for 3-5 minutes and remove carefully

title: Judy's Thanksgiving Dressing
ingredients: 3 bags of Safeway Artisan croutons (bakery area)
steps: Sautés the onions and celery in the stick of butter.
Mix vegetables into the croutons and add poultry seasoning, rubbed sage, salt and pepper (to taste)
Add chicken broth to make it wet and hold together if you squeeze it.
Cover with foil and bak for 30-45 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Lasagna
notes: If I make for guests I make the recipe as it is. If I make for my family of 4 I cut the sour cream, mozzarella cheese and cream cheese in half.
ingredients: 1 jar (25.5 oz) tomato basil pasta sauce
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes with basil and garlic, untrained
2 packages of cream cheese (8 oz each), softened
steps: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cook and drain noodles as directed on the package.
Cook the onions, beef and sausage over medium heat for 15 minutes stirring occasionally, until meat is cooked. Drain.
Stir in pasta sauce and tomatoes. Heat to a boiling, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, 1 cup mozzarella cheese, the egg and pepper flakes.

In untreated 14X10 lasagna pan, spread about 1 cup of meat sauce. Top with 4 cooked noodles, half of the cheese mixture, and 1 cup of meat sauce. Sprinkle with mozarella cheese and repeat. Last layer is 4 noodles, rest of meat sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Margaret Spags Monkey Bread
steps: Grease bundt pan
Cut each biscuit in half
Put sugar and cinnamon in a plastic bag and shake biscuit pieces in it
Put biscuit randomly in bundt pan
Melt butter in pan, add vanilla and rest of sugar and cinnamon mixture
Heat to dissolve sugar
Pour over biscuits and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: Mexican Chicken Crepes
ingredients: 1 4 oz. can diced green chiles, drained
2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, divided
steps: Stir together sour cream, garlic, chili powder, salt, cumin, chiles, 1 1/2 cup of Jack cheese, chicken and green onions. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the mixture down the center of each crepe, roll up to enclose and place crepes seam-side down in a single layer in a shallow 3-quart baking dish.
Bake covered in a 375 degree oven until hot, about 20 minutes.
Remove cover and sprinkle evenly with the cheddar cheese. Return to oven and bake uncovered until cheese melts, about 3-5 minutes.
To offer, serve lettuce, tomato, 1 cup of remaining Jack cheese and guacamole to sprinkle over individual servings
Crepes: Beat the eggs well, then beat in milk, salt, flour and butter. Cover and let stand for at least 30 minutes

Heat a skillet until moderately hot, then film it with butter using a brush. Using a ladle, pour in several tablespoons of batter, then quickly tilt the pan so that the batter spreads evenly in the thinnest possible layer. Cook for a few minutes and flip.
Cook other side for a few minutes and then remove to a plate. Repeat

title: Mom's meatballs
steps: Combine the ingredients in a large bowl and form medium sized meatballs.
Heat a pan with olive oil and on medium heat cook the meatballs, turning on each side after 2-3 minutes.
To finish cooking, add meatballs to a pot of sauce and heat on low for 1 hour or bake meatballs for 30 minutes.

title: Mom's Pork Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 of a sleeve of ground crackers
steps: Brown the ground pork and onions, once done drain
Add pork, crackers, salt, pepper, milk, egg and parsley to a bowl and mix
Transfer to a baking pan
Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: Muddy Buddies
ingredients: 1 package (6 oz.) semisweet chocolate chips (1 cup)
steps: Measure cereal into a large bowl and set aside
Microwave chocolate chips, butter and peanut butter, uncovered for 1 minute
Stir and microwave for 30 more seconds
Stir in vanilla
Pour chocolate mixture over cereal in bowl, stirring until evenly coated
Pour into large plastic food-storage bag
Add powdered sugar, seal and shake well
Spread on wax paper to cool
Store in airtight container in refrigerator

title: Nate's Firehouse Party Loaf
steps: Score bread lengthwise and crosswise without cutting through the bottom.
Insert cheese slices between cuts.
Combine remaining ingredients and drizzle over bread.
Wrap loaf in aluminum foil; place on an untreated baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.
Unwrap loaf and return to oven and bake an additional 10 minutes, uncovered until cheese is melted.

title: Pastry for Single-Crust Pie
steps: Stir together the flour and 1/4 t. salt. Using fork, put in pieces of shortening into flour mixture. Sprinkle 1 t. water over part of the mixture and gently toss with fork. Push moistened dough to the side of the bowl. Repeat moistening dough, using 1 T. of water at a time, till all the dough is moistened.
Form dough into a ball. On a lightly floured surface, use your hands to slightly flatten dough. Roll dough from center to edges into a circle about 12 inches in diameter.

To transfer pastry, wrap it around the rolling pin. Unroll pastry into a 9-inch pie plate. Trim pastry to 1/2 inch beyond edge of pie plate. Fold under extra pastry. Crimp edges as desired. Do no prick pastry
Bake as directed in individual recipes

title: Pecan Topped Pumpkin Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Combine flour and next 6 ingredients (through allspice) into a bowl
Place sugar, egg substitute, oil, buttermilk and eggs in a large bowl
Beat with a mixer at high speed until well blended
Add 2/3 cup water and pumpkin, beating at low speed until blended
Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture, beating at low speed just until combined
Spoon batter into 2 (9X5-inch) loaf pans coated with cooking spray
Sprinkle pecans on top
Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
Remove from pan and cool completely

title: Potato Pancakes
steps: Take the skins off of the potatoes and wash them
Cut up the potatoes and onion and put them in a food processor
Pulse potatoes and onions into a thick liquid
Put liquid in a bowl and add flour, eggs, salt and pepper
Mix well
Heat saucepan, add oil and drop in pancakes
Brown on each side for approximately 3 minutes
Top with sour cream

title: Rachel's Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 1 large can of whole, peeled tomatoes (or 3 large fresh tomatoes)
steps: Clean chicken
Melt butter in pan and add chicken
Brown chicken on each side and season with salt and pepper
This takes 5-8 minutes
Add water over chicken
Add tomatoes to pan, slightly cut of tomatoes
Add chicken seasoning, mix all ingredients in pan
Simmer for 1 hour

title: Rice and Pea Salad (Cabin Salad)
steps: Add olive oil, water, rice and bouillon cubes to pot, bring to boil, cover, simmer for 15 minutes
Stir in 2 T. parsley, 1 pkg frozen peas, green onions and lemon juice
Mix well
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: Salsa
steps: Chunk tomatoes in food processor (do not peel)
Suck off juice
Chop onions in food processor and add to tomatoes
Finely chop peppers in food processor and add to tomatoes
Add garlic, salt, lots of pepper and sugar to taste
Cook until onions are clear
Pack in pint jars and process in water batch for 20 minutes

title: Sam's Favorite White Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 7 oz. white chocolate, chopped into very small pieces
steps: In a large glass bowl, place the chopped white chocolate and set aside
Add the egg yolk and sugar to a small bowl and whisk until pale in color
In a saucepan, over low heat, bring 1/4 cup of the cream to a simmer, and slowly add the cream into the yolk and sugar mixture to temper
Pour the creamy mixture back into the pan and stir with a wooden spoon until it coats the back of it
Pour hot mixture into a fine mesh sieve placed directly over the bowl with the chopped chocolate
Stir until completely smooth
In another bowl, whip remaining 1 cup of cream to almost stiff peaks
Fold half of the whipped cream into the white chocolate mixture to lighten and then fold in the remaining whipped cream
Spoon the white chocolate mousse into 4 serving cups and refrigerate until set, approximately 1 hour
Garnish each serving with 3 blackberries

title: Spaghetti Meat Sauce
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers, seeded and diced
One 24 oz. jar good store-bought marinara sauce
1 whole rind from 1 wedge Parmesan, optional
1/2 c. Grated Parmesan, plus more for serving
2 pounds spaghetti, cooked al dents and tossed with olive oil, for serving
steps: In a large pot over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef and sausage until totally browned. Remove the meat from the pot with a slotted spoon and put it into a bowl. Set aside.

Discard any grease from the pot, but do not clean the pot. Drizzle in olive oil. When it is heated, throw in the onions and green peppers. Stir it around for 1 1/2 minutes, and then add the garlic. Stir and cook for an additional minute.

Pour in the stock and allow it to bubble for 1 1/2 minutes. Add in the crushed tomatoes, marinara sauce and tomato paste. Store to combine, and then add in sugar, salt, oregano, thyme, crushed red pepper and bay leaves. Stir and then add in the cooked ground beef and sausage and stir to combine. Place the lid on the pot and allow to simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add a little water or broth if need more liquid.

After an hour, add the minced parsley and the Parmesan rind (optional) and grated Parmesan. Stir to combine, and then put the lid back on and allow to simmer for another 30 minutes. Discard the bay leaves and rind before serving.
Top each serving with minced parsley and grated parmesan cheese

title: Spinach and Orzo Salad
steps: Cook orzo for 8-10 minutes, drain and rinse.
Combine the olive oil and vinegar with the pepper and basil and set the dressing aside.
Combine the rest of the ingredients, add in cooled orzo and add dressing to taste. It will make more than you will need.
Refrigerate salad

title: Spinach Fritters
steps: Thaw spinach and squeeze liquid out
Mix batter of egg, flour, milk, and salts
If batter is not pink add more seasoning salt
Add spinach
Heat a skillet on medium heat and add oil to pan
Add 2-3 T. of batter to pan to make small fritters
Cook on each side until brown

title: Strata
ingredients: 3 cups of meat (bacon, ham, sausage) and vegetables (onion, peppers, mushrooms)
steps: Mix the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a bowl
Put bread cubes in the bottom of a 9X13 baking dish
Pour egg mixture over bread cubes
In a separate bowl mix the cheese, butter, flour, mustard
Sprinkle cheese mixture over egg/bread
Sprinkle the meat and vegetable on top
Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour

title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Beat butter and shortening on a medium to high speed for 30 seconds
Add sugar, baking powder, and a dash of salt
Beat until combined, scraping bowl
Beat in egg and vanilla
Beat in as much flour as you can with the mixer
Stir in remaining flour
Divide dough in half
Cover and chill for 3 hours or till easy to handle
On a lightly floured surface, roll half at a time to 1/8 inch thick
Use cookie cutters to cut into shapes
Place on ungreased cookie sheet
Bake at 375 degrees for 7-8 minutes
See Butter Frosting

title: Sweet Potatoes Summer Salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.

Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Place in oven for 25 minutes and toss halfway through until golden brown.
Core, seed and dice the bell peppers into 1- inch cubes. Thinly slice the scallions and use the whites only.
With 15 minutes left to go on the sweet potatoes, toss the peppers onto the baking sheet and roast for the remaining 12-15 minutes.
Toss the sweet potatoes with the peppers, white scallions, feta and a squeeze of lime juice. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Whiskey Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 2 pounds of carrots, peeled and cut into 1/2 in pieces
steps: Melt 4 T of butter in a large skillet with a lid over high heat. Add half of the carrots and stir them around to brown them quickly for 1 minute. Remove to a plate and repeat with the remaining carrots.

Pour the whiskey into the skillet, taking care if you are cooking over an open flame. Let the whiskey bubble up and cook until slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium low, and add the other 4 T of butter and stir around until it is melted. Store in the brown sugar and some salt and pepper. Add the leaves from one of the springs of thyme and add carrots. Reduce heat to low and place lid on the skillet for 5 minutes.
Remove the lid and cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve garnished with the remaining thyme sprig.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
notes: Serve as a side to a beef roast
steps: Mix ingredients at room temperature until smooth
Put ungreased muffin tins in 425 degrees for 5 minutes
Remove and grease with pan drippings
Fill 1/2 full when hot again
Bake 15 minutes at 425 degrees and then 15 minutes at 350 degrees

title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Grease bottom and sides of a bread pan.
In a medium bowl combine the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder, salt and nutmeg. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine sugar, shredded zucchini, cooking oil, egg and mix well.
Add dry mixture to zucchini mixture and stir until moistened. Fold in the pecans (optional).
Spoon batter into the prepared pan and bake at 350 degrees for 55-60 minutes.
